scenarios: A researcher at a TB endemic site is uploading a dataset of Mycobacterium tuberculosis clinical isolates to the TB Portals system, including drug susceptibility profiles and patient treatment outcomes that require de-identification metadata.
A microbiology lab is submitting whole-genome sequencing data of carbapenem-resistant Enterobacteriaceae to the Antimicrobial Resistance Data Network (ACDN) to support global surveillance efforts.
An immunology group wants to archive a collection of HIV-1 envelope glycoprotein structures determined by cryo-EM in a structural biology repository with specific ontology tags for viral strains.

Public health officials are publishing a geospatial dataset mapping Anopheles mosquito distribution and insecticide resistance markers across Sub-Saharan Africa to a generalist data repository like Dryad.

A clinical trial coordinator needs to deposit a standardized protocol for Hepatitis C viral load quantification into a protocol-specific repository to ensure reproducibility across multiple study sites.
A bioinformatician is versioning a Python package used for phylogenetic analysis of Influenza A virus segments on GitHub and archiving a specific release snapshot on Zenodo for citation.
Epidemiologists are sharing a longitudinal cohort dataset tracking Zika virus infection rates and neurological complications in a secure repository that requires detailed ethical compliance metadata.
A virology core facility is submitting raw RNA-Seq reads from SARS-CoV-2 infected cell lines to the NCBI Sequence Read Archive, requiring precise biosample attribute mapping.
Pharmaceutical researchers are depositing chemical structure data and IC50 values for novel antimalarial compounds into PubChem to facilitate drug discovery interoperability.
A modeling team is publishing the output data and parameter files from a stochastic transmission model for COVID-19 variants on Figshare, emphasizing the assumptions used in the simulation.

A genomics lab is uploading transcriptomics data comparing host gene expression during acute versus latent Leishmaniasis infection to the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) with platform-specific metadata.

A consortium is releasing an interactive dashboard aggregating real-time surveillance data for multiple neglected tropical diseases, hosted on an institutional repository requiring clear provenance information for each data source.
